name: whossy-rules-tests
description: Emulator tests for firestore.rules/storage.rules (A6) and the notification Cloud Function triggers (B2). Requires Java for the emulators.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:triggers
scripts.test:triggers: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project whossy-app --only firestore,functions "node --test notifications.test.js"
